hero.h1: Gas Line Repair and Leak Detection in Hinsdale, IL
hero.sub: A faint gas smell in the basement, a red tag on the meter or an old line that once fed a stove that's long gone. Our licensed plumbers locate gas leaks, repair the piping and pressure-test it before service is restored. Our office is on Spinning Wheel Road.

blocks.h2: Smell Gas? Here's What to Do

steps.body: Don't touch switches, phones or appliances inside.

blocks.h2: When Gas Piping Needs a Plumber

tiles.h3: You Notice an Odor by an Appliance
tiles.body: Furnace, water heater, range, dryer or fireplace.
A repair and pressure test come first.
Old branches to removed appliances should be capped and tested.
Old brass connectors should be replaced.

bodies: We locate gas leaks with electronic detectors and by testing fittings one at a time, then pressure-test the whole system to confirm it's sealed.

In older Hinsdale homes, leaks often turn up at old unions and valves or on branches that were abandoned when an appliance was removed. Once the repair is made, the full system is tested again so service can be restored.

blocks.intro: Hinsdale gas piping ranges from early black iron to modern flexible pipe.

items.body: The pipe lasts, but unions and valves wear after many decades.
Lines that fed old stoves, lights or space heaters should be properly capped.
Lines to grills, fire pits and heaters need correct sizing and protection.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave, then call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.
items.answer: Leave the house right away without touching switches. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside, then call us for the repair.

items.q: Do you offer gas leak detection without a shutoff?
items.answer: Yes. If you notice a faint odor and the utility hasn't shut off service, we can test the system and find the source.

items.preview: The utility up to the meter, you after it.
items.answer: Nicor Gas is responsible up to and including the meter. Piping after the meter belongs to the homeowner.

items.q: Can you cap old gas lines in our home?
items.answer: Yes. We cap abandoned branches properly and pressure-test the system.

items.q: How much does gas leak detection and repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how much pipe needs work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
